q: 'Rail Soudha', situated on Gadag Road at Hubballi, is the headquarters building of the:
e: Rail Soudha on Gadag Road at Hubballi is the headquarters building of South Western Railway, whose headquarters is at Hubballi in Karnataka.

q: Which of the following is the westernmost railway station of India?
e: Naliya station in Kutch district, Gujarat, is the terminus of the Bhuj-Naliya line and is recognised as the westernmost railway station of India.

q: Tunnel T-50, India's longest transportation tunnel with a length of 12.775 km on the Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link, is located between which two stations?
e: Tunnel T-50, 12.775 km long on the Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link, lies between Sumber and Khari stations and is India's longest transportation tunnel.

q: The Danapur division of Indian Railways, which completed one hundred years of its existence in January 2025, was originally established in the year:
e: Danapur division was originally established in 1925, so it completed one hundred years of its existence in January 2025.

q: Petrapole, the Indian rail station on the India-Bangladesh border in West Bengal, is directly connected by rail across the border to which station in Bangladesh?
e: Petrapole in West Bengal is linked across the India-Bangladesh border to Benapole station in Bangladesh on the Petrapole-Benapole rail route.

q: The Salem division of Southern Railway was created mainly by bifurcating which existing division?
e: Salem division of Southern Railway was created mainly by bifurcating the Palakkad division, along with portions reorganised from other divisions.

q: The Ambala division of Northern Railway, created by transferring sections from the Delhi and Firozpur divisions, was formed in the year:
e: Ambala division of Northern Railway was formed in 1987 by transferring sections from the Delhi and Firozpur divisions.

q: The diesel locomotive factory at Marhowrah (Marhaura) in the Saran district of Bihar is a joint venture of Indian Railways with which global company?
e: The diesel locomotive factory at Marhowrah in Saran, Bihar, is a joint venture of Indian Railways with Wabtec, formerly GE Transportation.

q: The Thiruvananthapuram division of Southern Railway, the southernmost railway division of India, was formed in the year:
e: Thiruvananthapuram division of Southern Railway, the southernmost division of India, was formed in 1979.

q: In connection with the online recording of Annual Performance Appraisal Reports of government employees, 'SPARROW' stands for:

options.A: Smart Performance Appraisal Report Recording Online Window
options.B: Systematic Performance Appraisal and Review Recording Online Window
options.C: Smart Personnel Appraisal Report and Record Online Window
options.D: Standard Performance Assessment Report Recording Online Window

e: SPARROW stands for Smart Performance Appraisal Report Recording Online Window, the online system for recording Annual Performance Appraisal Reports.

q: In the field of social security insurance schemes, 'PMJJBY' stands for:

options.A: Pradhan Mantri Jan Jeevan Bima Yojana
options.B: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bachat Yojana
options.C: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
options.D: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Janani Bima Yojana

e: PMJJBY stands for Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana, the life insurance scheme under the social security insurance schemes.

q: In the field of social security insurance schemes, 'PMSBY' stands for:
e: PMSBY stands for Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana, the accidental insurance scheme under the social security insurance schemes.

q: In the Goods and Services Tax (GST) system, 'GSTN' stands for:
e: GSTN stands for Goods and Services Tax Network, the technology backbone that provides IT infrastructure for GST.

q: In government welfare delivery, the abbreviation 'DBT' stands for:
e: DBT stands for Direct Benefit Transfer, the system of transferring subsidies and welfare benefits directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts.

q: In the Government of India's expenditure management system, 'PFMS' stands for:
e: PFMS stands for Public Financial Management System, the Government of India's platform for tracking and managing public expenditure and fund flow.

q: In the pension administration of the Government of India, 'CPAO' stands for:
e: CPAO stands for Central Pension Accounting Office, which handles authorisation and accounting of pensions of Central Government employees.

q: In the banking and insurance sector, 'DICGC' stands for:

options.A: Deposit Insurance and Credit Grievance Corporation
options.B: Deposit Insurance Corporation and General Credit
options.C: Development Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation
options.D: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation

e: DICGC stands for Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation, which insures bank deposits and guarantees credit facilities.

q: In the pension sector, 'PFRDA' stands for:

options.A: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
options.B: Pension Fund Regulation and Distribution Authority
options.C: Provident Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
options.D: Pension Fund Research and Development Agency

e: PFRDA stands for Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority, the regulator for the pension sector including the National Pension System.

q: Under the Goods and Services Tax, the abbreviation 'ITC' stands for:
e: ITC under GST stands for Input Tax Credit, the credit a business gets for tax paid on inputs against tax payable on output.

q: In railway and government works contracts, the abbreviation 'PVC' stands for:
e: PVC in works contracts stands for Price Variation Clause, which adjusts contract price for changes in material, labour and other cost indices.

q: In May 2025, girder launching was completed on the Noney bridge of the Jiribam-Imphal new rail line in Manipur, whose piers rise to about 141 metres. This bridge is recognised as the:

options.B: First cable-stayed railway bridge of India

e: The Noney bridge on the Jiribam-Imphal line, with piers about 141 metres high, is recognised as the world's tallest railway pier bridge, and girder launching was completed in May 2025.

q: In October 2025, the first-ever automobile rake to reach the Kashmir Valley arrived at the Anantnag Goods Shed from the Gati Shakti Terminal at Manesar. The rake carried cars manufactured by:
e: The first automobile rake to reach Kashmir Valley at Anantnag Goods Shed in October 2025 from Manesar carried cars manufactured by Maruti Suzuki.

q: Japan has agreed to introduce which next-generation Shinkansen trainset on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train corridor, to be introduced simultaneously in India and Japan?
e: Japan has agreed to introduce the E10 series next-generation Shinkansen on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor, to be introduced simultaneously in India and Japan around 2030.

q: In July 2026, the first direct commercial container freight train between India and Nepal ran from Kolkata Port to which customs yard in Nepal?
e: The first direct commercial container freight train between India and Nepal in July 2026 ran from Kolkata Port to Biratnagar Customs Yard in Nepal under the revised Rail Transit Protocol.

q: India's first dedicated high-speed test track, a 59 km facility being developed by the Research Designs and Standards Organisation between Gudha and Thathana Mithri for trials of rolling stock at speeds up to 220 kmph, is located in which State?
e: India's first dedicated high-speed test track, 59 km between Gudha and Thathana Mithri being developed by RDSO for trials up to 220 kmph, is located in Rajasthan.

q: Three Amrit Bharat Express trains were flagged off from Thiruvananthapuram on 23 January 2026. One of these trains connects Nagercoil Junction with:
e: Of the three Amrit Bharat Express trains flagged off from Thiruvananthapuram on 23 January 2026, the Nagercoil Junction service connects Nagercoil with Mangaluru Junction.

q: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off on 15 September 2025 connects Jogbani in Bihar, near the Nepal border, with which station?
e: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off on 15 September 2025 connects Jogbani in Bihar, near the Nepal border, with Danapur.

q: On the Dimapur-Kohima new rail line, freight operations commenced for the first time in September 2025 at which station, making it the third major railway station of Nagaland?
e: On the Dimapur-Kohima new line, freight operations commenced for the first time in September 2025 at Molvom, which became the third major railway station of Nagaland.

q: Surekha Yadav, Asia's first woman loco pilot, retired from Central Railway in September 2025 after completing how many years of service?
e: Surekha Yadav, Asia's first woman loco pilot, retired from Central Railway on 30 September 2025 after completing 36 years of service, having joined in 1989.

q: In October 2025, the Aurangabad railway station of the Nanded division in Maharashtra was officially renamed as:
e: Aurangabad railway station of Nanded division in Maharashtra was officially renamed Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in October 2025, matching the renamed city.

q: The Government Accounting Standards Advisory Board (GASAB), which advises on accounting standards for the Union and State Governments, was constituted by the:

options.B: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

e: The Government Accounting Standards Advisory Board (GASAB) was constituted by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India to advise on government accounting standards.

q: The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) was established as a development financial institution under an Act of Parliament passed in the year:
e: The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) was established under the NaBFID Act passed in 2021 as a development financial institution.

q: India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL), the wholly owned Government of India company that provides long-term finance for infrastructure projects, was set up in the year:
e: India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL), a wholly owned Government of India company for long-term infrastructure finance, was set up in 2006.

q: In March 2019, Power Finance Corporation (PFC) acquired the Government of India's majority stake in which other power-sector PSU?
e: In March 2019, Power Finance Corporation acquired the Government of India's majority stake of about 52.63 percent in REC Limited, another power-sector PSU.

q: The Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) functions under the administrative control of the:

options.B: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

e: The Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) functions under the administrative control of the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.

q: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM), the public procurement portal, is operated by a Special Purpose Vehicle set up as a:

options.D: Section 8 (not-for-profit) company under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry

e: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is operated by GeM SPV, a Section 8 not-for-profit company under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

q: Under the concession arrangement for the Dedicated Freight Corridors, the Track Access Charges for using the freight corridor network are paid to DFCCIL by the:
e: Under the concession arrangement for Dedicated Freight Corridors, Track Access Charges for using the corridor network are paid to DFCCIL by Indian Railways.

q: The execution of the Sivok-Rangpo new railway line project, which will give Sikkim its first rail connectivity, has been entrusted to which railway PSU?

options.D: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India

e: Execution of the Sivok-Rangpo new line, which will give Sikkim its first rail connectivity, has been entrusted to IRCON International Limited.

q: The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC), which insures bank deposits in India, is a wholly owned subsidiary of the:
e: DICGC, which insures bank deposits in India up to the prescribed limit, is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India.

q: Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Private Limited (BRBNMPL), the wholly owned subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India, operates its currency note printing presses at:
e: BRBNMPL, the RBI subsidiary for currency note printing, operates its presses at Mysuru in Karnataka and Salboni in West Bengal.

q: The headquarters of the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI), the principal financial institution for the MSME sector, is located at:
e: The headquarters of SIDBI, the principal financial institution for the MSME sector, is located at Lucknow in Uttar Pradesh.

q: The Controller General of Accounts (CGA), the Principal Accounting Adviser to the Government of India, functions under which department of the Ministry of Finance?
e: The Controller General of Accounts, Principal Accounting Adviser to the Government of India, functions under the Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance.

q: The Export-Import Bank of India (EXIM Bank), the principal financial institution for financing and promoting India's foreign trade, was set up under an Act of Parliament of the year:
e: The Export-Import Bank of India was set up under the EXIM Bank Act of 1981 to finance and promote India's foreign trade.

q: The Signal and Telecommunication Workshop of Indian Railways located at Mettuguda in Secunderabad functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Signal and Telecommunication Workshop at Mettuguda in Secunderabad functions under South Central Railway, in whose territory Secunderabad lies.

q: The Zonal Railway Training Institute (ZRTI) at Chandausi in Uttar Pradesh belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Zonal Railway Training Institute at Chandausi in Uttar Pradesh belongs to Northern Railway.

q: Which of the following was the first narrow gauge railway line in India, opened in 1862 under the Gaekwar's Baroda State Railway?
e: The Dabhoi-Miyagam line, opened in 1862 under the Gaekwar's Baroda State Railway, was the first narrow gauge railway line in India.

q: The new 'X' class steam locomotives built in recent years for the Nilgiri Mountain Railway were manufactured by which workshop of Indian Railways?
e: The new X class steam locomotives for the Nilgiri Mountain Railway were manufactured by the Golden Rock Railway Workshop at Tiruchirappalli.

q: The flagship and largest inland container depot (ICD) of the Container Corporation of India (CONCOR) is located at:
e: The flagship and largest inland container depot of CONCOR is located at Tughlakabad in Delhi.

q: The Rangiya division of the Northeast Frontier Railway was created on 1 April 2003 by bifurcating which existing division?
e: Rangiya division of Northeast Frontier Railway was created on 1 April 2003 by bifurcating the Alipurduar division.

q: The Electric Locomotive Workshop at Bhusaval in Maharashtra, which undertakes periodic overhaul of electric locomotives, belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Locomotive Workshop at Bhusaval in Maharashtra, which does periodic overhaul of electric locomotives, belongs to Central Railway.

q: The Alipurduar division of the Northeast Frontier Railway was formed in the year:
e: The Alipurduar division of Northeast Frontier Railway was formed in 1958, when the Northeast Frontier Railway itself was created.

q: The Signal and Telecommunication Workshop of Central Railway in Mumbai is located at:
e: The Signal and Telecommunication Workshop of Central Railway in Mumbai is located at Byculla.

q: The Signal and Telecommunication Workshop of the Northeast Frontier Railway is located at which place in Guwahati?
e: The Signal and Telecommunication Workshop of Northeast Frontier Railway is located at Pandu in Guwahati.

q: The North Western Railway zone, headquartered at Jaipur, came into existence in the year:
e: North Western Railway, headquartered at Jaipur, came into existence on 1 October 2002 during the reorganisation of railway zones.

q: In banking, 'RTGS' stands for:
e: RTGS stands for Real Time Gross Settlement, the system for large-value fund transfers settled individually in real time.

q: In international banking, 'SWIFT' stands for:

options.A: Society for World International Fund Transfer
options.B: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication
options.C: System for Worldwide Interbank Financial Transactions
options.D: Society for Worldwide International Financial Transfer

e: SWIFT stands for Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication, the network banks use for secure international financial messaging.

q: In income tax, 'TAN' stands for:

options.C: Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number

e: TAN in income tax stands for Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number, required by persons deducting or collecting tax at source.

q: In the Goods and Services Tax system, 'GSTIN' stands for:

options.B: Goods and Services Taxpayer Index Number
options.D: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number

e: GSTIN stands for Goods and Services Tax Identification Number, the 15-digit unique number allotted to each GST-registered taxpayer.

q: In customs and trade classification, 'HSN' stands for:
e: HSN in customs and trade classification stands for Harmonised System of Nomenclature, the global system for classifying traded goods.

q: In the Goods and Services Tax system, 'IGST' stands for:
e: IGST stands for Integrated Goods and Services Tax, levied on inter-state supplies of goods and services by the Central Government.

q: In income tax, 'TDS' stands for:
e: TDS stands for Tax Deducted at Source, the income tax collected by the payer at the time of making specified payments.

q: In banking transactions, 'NACH' stands for:
e: NACH stands for National Automated Clearing House, NPCI's system for bulk, recurring electronic payments and collections.

q: In the Indian payments system, 'NPCI' stands for:
e: NPCI stands for National Payments Corporation of India, the umbrella organisation for retail payments and settlement systems in India.

q: In accountancy, 'GAAP' stands for:
e: GAAP stands for Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, the common set of accounting rules and standards followed in financial reporting.

q: In financial reporting, 'IFRS' stands for:
e: IFRS stands for International Financial Reporting Standards, the global accounting standards issued by the IASB.

q: The Amrit Bharat Express flagged off on 23 January 2026 connects Thiruvananthapuram Central with which station in Tamil Nadu?
e: The Amrit Bharat Express flagged off on 23 January 2026 connects Thiruvananthapuram Central with Tambaram in Tamil Nadu.

q: The Amrit Bharat Express flagged off on 23 January 2026 connects Thiruvananthapuram North with which station in Telangana?
e: The Amrit Bharat Express flagged off on 23 January 2026 connects Thiruvananthapuram North with Charlapalli in Telangana.

q: Which of the following Amrit Bharat Express trains was among the nine new services flagged off in January 2026?
e: The Sealdah-Banaras Amrit Bharat Express was among the nine new Amrit Bharat services flagged off in January 2026 linking West Bengal and Assam with other regions.

q: The Amrit Bharat Express flagged off in January 2026 connects Alipurduar in West Bengal with which station in Maharashtra?
e: The Amrit Bharat Express flagged off in January 2026 connects Alipurduar in West Bengal with Panvel in Maharashtra.

q: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off on 20 June 2025 by the Prime Minister from Siwan connects Patliputra with which city?
e: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off on 20 June 2025 from Siwan connects Patliputra with Gorakhpur in Uttar Pradesh.

q: The daily time-tabled parcel train introduced in September 2025 for the benefit of apple growers of Kashmir carries apples from Budgam to which station in Delhi?
e: The daily time-tabled parcel train introduced in September 2025 for Kashmir apple growers carries apples from Budgam to Adarsh Nagar in Delhi.

q: Which of the following multi-tracking projects was among the four projects approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs in July 2025?
e: The Itarsi-Nagpur fourth line was among the four multi-tracking projects approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs in July 2025.

q: The Vande Bharat 4.0, the next-generation trainset announced by the Railway Minister in October 2025, is being designed keeping in view which additional market besides domestic services?
e: Vande Bharat 4.0, the next-generation trainset announced in October 2025, is being designed for domestic services as well as export markets.

q: The priority corridor of Patna Metro, inaugurated in October 2025, connects New ISBT with which station?
e: The priority corridor of Patna Metro, inaugurated in October 2025, connects New ISBT with Bhoothnath as its other terminal station in the first phase.

q: The priority corridor of Bhopal Metro, on which commercial operations began in December 2025, connects Subhash Nagar with which station?
e: The priority corridor of Bhopal Metro, on which commercial operations began on 21 December 2025, connects Subhash Nagar with AIIMS.

q: 'Mission Amanat', the initiative under which details and photographs of passengers' lost luggage are uploaded on the zonal railway's website so that the owners can identify and claim it, was launched by the:

options.C: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation

e: Mission Amanat, under which details and photographs of lost luggage are uploaded on the zonal website for owners to claim it, was launched by the Railway Protection Force.

q: Which organisation holds the distinction of being the first metro or railway project in the world to be registered by the United Nations under the Clean Development Mechanism (CDM), enabling it to claim carbon credits for regenerative braking?
e: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation is the first metro or railway project in the world registered by the United Nations under the Clean Development Mechanism for regenerative braking carbon credits.

q: Pune IT City Metro Rail Ltd, the SPV implementing the Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Pune Metro Line-3 on PPP basis, was formed by a joint venture of TRIL Urban Transport Pvt Ltd (Tata Group) with:
e: Pune IT City Metro Rail Ltd, implementing Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Line-3 on PPP basis, is a joint venture of TRIL Urban Transport (Tata Group) with Siemens Project Ventures GmbH.

q: The Jammu Mass Rapid Transit Corporation and the Srinagar Mass Rapid Transit Corporation are wholly owned by:
e: The Jammu Mass Rapid Transit Corporation and Srinagar Mass Rapid Transit Corporation are wholly owned by the Government of Jammu and Kashmir.

q: The Andhra Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation, set up to implement the Vijayawada metro rail project, was earlier known as:
e: The Andhra Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation, set up for the Vijayawada metro project, was earlier known as Amaravati Metro Rail Corporation Ltd.

q: The operations and maintenance of the Rapid Metro Gurugram was taken over in October 2019 from Rapid MetroRail Gurgaon Ltd by:
e: Operations and maintenance of Rapid Metro Gurugram was taken over in October 2019 from Rapid MetroRail Gurgaon Ltd by Delhi Metro Rail Corporation.

q: In December 2023, the operation and maintenance of the Mumbai Monorail was handed over by MMRDA to:

options.B: Maha Mumbai Metro Operation Corporation Ltd

e: In December 2023, operation and maintenance of the Mumbai Monorail was handed over by MMRDA to Maha Mumbai Metro Operation Corporation Ltd.

q: The Detailed Project Reports for the proposed metro rail projects of Coimbatore and Madurai were prepared by:
e: The Detailed Project Reports for the proposed metro projects of Coimbatore and Madurai were prepared by Chennai Metro Rail Limited.

q: Urban Mass Transit Company Ltd (UMTC), the urban mobility consultancy promoted with support of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, was incorporated in the year:
e: Urban Mass Transit Company Ltd (UMTC), the urban mobility consultancy supported by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, was incorporated on 13 April 1993.

q: Star Track Terminals Pvt Ltd, which operates a container freight station at Dadri, is a joint venture of CONCOR with:
e: Star Track Terminals Pvt Ltd, operating a container freight station at Dadri, is a joint venture of CONCOR with Maersk, with Maersk holding the majority stake.

q: Sampige, Mallige, Parijaata and Kanaka — the names of the four corridors of the Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project — are the Kannada names of:
e: Sampige, Mallige, Parijaata and Kanaka, the four Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project corridors, are Kannada names of flowers.

q: TCI CONCOR Multimodal Solutions Pvt Ltd, the joint venture providing end-to-end multimodal logistics services, was formed by CONCOR with:
e: TCI CONCOR Multimodal Solutions Pvt Ltd was formed by CONCOR with Transport Corporation of India to provide end-to-end multimodal logistics services.

q: The safety certification required before a new metro rail line in India (outside Kolkata) is opened for commercial operation is granted by the:

options.D: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

e: Safety certification before a new metro line outside Kolkata opens commercially is granted by the Commissioner of Metro Railway Safety.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Ludhiana belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Ludhiana belongs to Northern Railway, under whose Firozpur division Ludhiana falls.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Barauni belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Barauni belongs to East Central Railway, under whose Sonpur division Barauni falls.

q: The Electric-cum-Diesel Loco Shed at Patratu belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Electric-cum-Diesel Loco Shed at Patratu belongs to East Central Railway, under whose Dhanbad division Patratu falls.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Gooty belongs to which zonal railway?
e: Guntakal division now belongs to the South Coast Railway (HQ Visakhapatnam). (Source: Ministry of Railways Gazette notification dated 04.05.2026 constituting South Coast Railway, comprising Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam divisions; operations from 01.06.2026.)

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Ernakulam, the only loco shed in Kerala, belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Ernakulam, the only loco shed in Kerala, belongs to Southern Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Valsad belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Valsad belongs to Western Railway, under whose Mumbai Central division Valsad falls.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Izatnagar belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Izatnagar belongs to North Eastern Railway, whose headquarters division at Izatnagar it serves.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Malda Town, though located in West Bengal, is maintained by which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Malda Town, though located in West Bengal, is maintained by Northeast Frontier Railway, under whose Katihar division it falls.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Ajni (Nagpur) belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Ajni in Nagpur belongs to Central Railway, under whose Nagpur division Ajni falls.

q: The MEMU Car Shed at Kollam belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The MEMU Car Shed at Kollam belongs to Southern Railway, under whose Thiruvananthapuram division Kollam falls.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Agra belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Agra belongs to North Central Railway, under whose Agra division it falls.

q: In railway ticketing, 'CoTVM' stands for:

options.A: Coin and Cash Operated Ticket Vending Machine

e: CoTVM in railway ticketing stands for Coin and Cash Operated Ticket Vending Machine, a self-service machine for issuing unreserved tickets.
